da-non-sequitur.evidence: [sidecar review 2026-11-15, issue #8030] **Non-sequitur.** The statement says Sk_q is generated by torus knots and the Hopf link, and every hadron has a terminal skein resolution. The prf never addresses generation; it fits hadronic masses. (For S³ the statement is near-trivial anyway: the skein module is rank 1, so every link is a scalar multiple of the empty link.) "Determined without free parameters" contradicts the Lean's own Section-10 docstring, which calls μ_u and μ_d "fitted". The Lean ref `terminal_resolution_hadronic_mass` checks \ | proton_topological − proton_mass_MeV\ | < 1e−3 and similar for the neutron and deuteron. These are absolute nucleon masses in MeV, which the 2026-08-11 owner ruling excised as predictions.
